coverage.scope: Request repetition with the explicitly taught whole chunk; distinguish a sound-production problem from a missing word. Grammar inside the chunk is analyzed later.

definition.title: Recall familiar material
definition.subtitle: Read and speak here
definition.context: Use a few familiar words in a short exchange, then demonstrate understanding of a micro-story.

questions.prompt: Your partner spoke while you were distracted. Ask them to repeat using the taught whole chunk, pause, then acknowledge the repeated message.
questions.context:
Your partner spoke while you were distracted; you did not hear the message. Its content is unspecified. Ask for repetition with the taught chunk, wait, then acknowledge hearing the repeated turn without inventing its content.
Familiar meanings available: please say it once more.
questions.label: Take your speaking turn

rubric.text: I used the taught repetition-request chunk for the missed message.
I left a turn for the partner and distinguished missing sound from an unknown word.

definition.summary: Your results distinguish checked answers from self-reviewed practice. Unsampled material and unassessed proficiency remain separate.
